verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly has a first-party Approvals feature in which a member making a flag change can request approval from a member or team in their project. The evidence only describes this as an option, not as a mandatory gate enforced on production environments. Missing for 10: documented evidence that approvals can be required or enforced per environment (e.g. production-only), detail on reviewer and change-request workflow configuration, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
